notes.title: Demo 1.5.3 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Additional Information[/h3]
[list]
[*]Portuguese - Brazil has been added. (Thanks to the person who provided the translation)
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The terrain of level 23 has been adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 1.5.2 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game screen was not displayed correctly in resolutions other than 16:9.
[*]Fixed the camera zoom-in/zoom-out functionality code.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 1.5.1 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the title menu could not be controlled after adjusting options in certain situations.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 1.5.0 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Russian has been added.
[*]A feature to check control keys in the in-game menu has been added.
[*]Hold to move feature has been added.
[list]
[*]While holding the movement key, the character will keep moving.
[*]You can toggle this feature in the options.
[/list]
[*]A feature to move using WASD keys has been added.
[*]A quick character selection feature has been added.
[list]
[*]You can switch to the desired character by pressing the 1, 2, or 3 keys.
[*]The C key function to change characters is still available.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The terrain of level 23 has been adjusted.
[*]The map images for level 3 and level 30 have been corrected.
[*]Movement using the left stick with a controller has been improved.
[*]The interval between performing the hold to move and undo function has been adjusted.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.4.1

The following languages have been added:

notes.title: Japanese Language Support Planned / Demo Patch 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]Japanese language support[/b][/h2]
[h3]Japanese language support will be available in the full version of the game.[/h3]
[list]
[*]A Japanese store page has been launched.
[*]Japanese has been added to Demo version 1.4.0.
[/list]


[h2][b]Demo 1.4.0[/b][/h2]
[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Japanese has been added.
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]When launching the game for the first time, the game language will be set according to the Steam language in use.
[/list]
